faqs.question: Do travellers ever pay for Spotto?
faqs.answer: No. The traveller app is free forever, with no premium tier. Vendor subscriptions fund the whole thing, which keeps our recommendations honest: we only win when travellers actually show up at your counter.

faqs.question: What happens when my Premium trial ends?
faqs.answer: You drop back to Starter automatically. Your listing, photos and review history stay exactly as they are; you just lose the Premium tools until you subscribe.

faqs.question: Can I switch between monthly and yearly billing?
faqs.answer: Anytime. Switching to yearly applies the two-free-months rate at your next renewal, and switching back to monthly takes effect when the paid year runs out.

faqs.question: How does Spotto keep listings honest?
faqs.answer: Paying never buys a better rating or a fake review. Boosts change where you appear, clearly labelled, but every spot on the map got there because a local reviewer rated it worth a traveller's time.

faqs.question: My business is seasonal. Can I pause?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium can be paused for up to four months a year. Your listing stays live on Starter while you're closed, and your stamp cards pick up where they left off.

faqs.question: How fast does my listing go live?
faqs.answer: Once you submit your business details and BR certificate, our local curation team verifies your listing within 24 hours.

stories.title: How to Ride the Ella Odyssey Train Without Losing Your Mind
stories.summary: Where to stand, when to buy tickets, and how to spot the Nine Arches bridge without 400 selfie sticks in your frame.
stories.body:
The Kandy-to-Ella train is consistently voted one of the most scenic rail journeys on earth. But doing it smoothly takes a few tricks only locals know.

### 1. Board at Peradeniya, Not Kandy
Kandy station is packed. If you board at Peradeniya Junction (one stop earlier), you have five extra minutes to stow bags and grab window seats.

### 2. Stand on the Right Side
From Hatton to Haputale, the sheer valley views and tea waterfalls are almost exclusively on the right side of the carriage direction.

### 3. Chai from the Platform Vendors
When the train halts at Pattipola (the highest station at 1,898m), don't miss the ginger tea in clay cups from the track-side aunties.

stories.title: The Golden Hour Kottu: A Southern Province Masterclass
stories.summary: Behind the steel blades at Nana's Shack: how chopped godamba roti, roast chicken gravy, and banana peppers become Sri Lanka's ultimate comfort.
stories.body:
At 6:30 PM along the Matara road, the rhythmic clang of steel blades hitting cast iron signals that dinner is ready.

Nana started grilling kottu in 1998. The secret isn't fancy spices—it's the fresh curry leaves fried at the very first second the griddle reaches peak heat.
